mapper.select: SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM crm_business owner_user_id = #{owner} GROUP BY stage ORDER BY FIELD(stage, 'NEW', 'QUALIFIED', 'CONTACTED', 'NEGOTIATING', 'WON', 'LOST')

SELECT u.username AS owner, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead l WHERE l.owner_id = u.id) AS leadCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_business b WHERE b.owner_user_id = u.id) AS businessCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_business b WHERE b.owner_user_id = u.id AND b.stage = 'WON') AS wonCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.amount), 0) FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.owner_user_id = u.id) AS contractAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.received_amount), 0) FROM crm_receivable r WHERE r.owner_user_id = u.id) AS receivedAmount FROM sys_user u WHERE u.enabled = TRUE AND u.id = #{owner} ORDER BY contractAmount DESC, u.username
